name: segmented-control
summary: Picks one of a few options from a row of items, named by its field, the checked one drawn as the indicator: the arrow keys move the choice and pass a disabled item, with read-only and disabled.

notCovered.name: ui-segmented-control-indicator
notCovered.why: UI SDK writes the checked item's position and size onto it as a style attribute, which the check refuses on a stage, so the stage holds none and part.css does not style it; the checked item draws the indicator's look itself, so the choice moves at once and does not slide.

notCovered.name: invalid
notCovered.why: UI SDK's sheet gives a segmented control no invalid look, and no segmented control here sits in an invalid field, so the stage holds no invalid state.

notCovered.name: the touch target
notCovered.why: Under a coarse pointer UI SDK lays an empty box over each item, 2.75rem tall, so a tap near it reaches it. It draws nothing, so no light reads its size, and the part leaves it as UI SDK sets it.
